associations.detail: The canonical seed starts with only 13 active nonzero lags, but the current one-packet actuator changes a median of 51 of 166 lag coordinates.
associations.implication: The bottleneck is not lack of signal. It is lack of an actuator whose footprint matches that sparse signal.

associations.detail: A quick exhaustive unordered 2-packet probe over 55,611 pairs found 0 improving pairs and 1 neutral pair. Yet 239 pairs lowered l1 and 53,299 lowered max_abs.
associations.implication: Magnitude can be improved locally, but support almost always diffuses. Any useful composite library must control support flux before it chases l1 or max_abs.

associations.association: Low splash is necessary but not sufficient
associations.detail: Only 860 of 55,611 packet pairs changed at most 25 lag coordinates, and only 1 of those 860 was nonworsening.
associations.implication: Anti-splash filtering alone will not reveal a useful library unless it is combined with a stronger structural grammar.

associations.detail: Among the low-splash 2-packet pairs, 793 were same-channel and only 67 were cross-channel.
associations.implication: The most credible composite grammar is channel-local first, with cross-channel packets added only when a graph argument demands them.

associations.detail: Low-splash same-channel pairs concentrate at separations 83, 85, 81 and at short offsets 1, 2, 4.
associations.implication: The prime involution midpoint and tiny local offsets are natural seed-independent generators for 4-packet closures.

associations.association: Neutrality exists, but it is extremely thin
associations.detail: The one-packet library has exactly one neutral packet, and the 2-packet probe found exactly one neutral pair with zero lag change.
associations.implication: If strategically neutral motion exists at all, it likely lives on a very sparse neutral network and needs an explicit neutral-walk controller.

associations.association: Graph locality is more honest than index locality
associations.detail: Raw q and s adjacency does not match effect locality. Exact delta fingerprints induce a more faithful defect-packet graph than a 1D packet lattice.
associations.implication: Future CA claims should live on a sparse influence graph or a causal-cone hypergraph, not on raw packet index neighborhoods.

associations.association: Symmetry-safe is not the same as family-restricted
associations.detail: Orbit quotienting removes duplicate representatives, while skew, Williamson, Turyn, or other family restrictions can erase valid search directions.
associations.implication: Use canonical representatives under the allowed symmetry group, but do not hard-code a structured family into the library.

associations.association: Composite grammar is acceptable; seed-picked packets are not
associations.detail: A fixed grammar generated from representation symmetries, run-boundary templates, and defect-graph cycles can be defended. Manually keeping only the packet tuples that help this seed cannot.
associations.implication: The anti-basis-engineering line is crossed when packet indices are selected because they empirically helped one frontier instance rather than because they satisfy a prior grammar.

associations.association: A no-library certificate may be the highest-value outcome
associations.detail: The one-packet library is frozen and the naive 2-packet library is almost as frozen, with a higher median lag footprint of 57.
associations.implication: A fixed-grammar exhaustive barrier for 4-packet and run-boundary composites may be more scientifically valuable than another policy-tuning pass.

forced_bridges.to: Composite packet discovery on the canonical seed
forced_bridges.mechanism: Treat active lags as check nodes and packets as variable nodes; build short collective flips that resolve a small trapping set while minimizing external spill, instead of ranking single packets independently.

Enumerate composites by group orbit, keep one canonical representative per orbit, and measure performance only after quotienting duplicates. This preserves symmetry safety without imposing a new family.
Generate 4-packet and run-boundary composites only by canonical augmentation steps, so the search tree never grows duplicate packet tuples and does not need seed-specific pruning.

forced_bridges.from: Very large-scale neighborhood search and improvement graphs
forced_bridges.mechanism: Replace a hand-picked basis with a bounded improvement graph whose edges are admissible packet interactions; search short cycles and paths in that graph rather than engineering packet tuples by hand.
Use retained neutral or near-neutral composites as plateau transporters, but cap the walk length and keep the walk on a symmetry-quotiented composite graph.

forced_bridges.from: Self-avoiding walks for low-autocorrelation binary sequences
forced_bridges.mechanism: Allow short self-avoiding walks across a sparse neutral corridor of retained composites, preventing immediate backtracking while staying local in the retained graph.

forced_bridges.from: Hybrid cellular automata in topology optimization
forced_bridges.to: CA over a retained composite library
forced_bridges.mechanism: Interpret weighted defect mass as local stress and redistribute activation pressure across neighboring composites under a hard activity budget, rather than rescoring the whole library every step.

forced_bridges.from: Wavelet lifting and reversible predict-update schemes
forced_bridges.mechanism: Compose packet tuples so one substep predicts and exposes spill while the next substep cancels the far-field component, leaving a reversible coarse-to-fine local actuator.

anomaly_results.constraint: Compare the known 1-packet library to an exhaustive unordered 2-packet library on the canonical seed.
anomaly_results.observation: The 1-packet library has 0 improving moves, 1 neutral move, and median splash 51. The naive 2-packet library also has 0 improving moves, only 1 neutral move, and median splash 57.
anomaly_results.implication: Moving from 1 to 2 packets by itself does not solve the bottleneck; unstructured larger neighborhoods just buy more splash.

anomaly_results.constraint: Impose a low-splash cap of at most 25 changed lag coordinates on 2-packet composites.
anomaly_results.observation: Only 860 of 55,611 pairs satisfy the cap, and only 1 of those 860 is nonworsening.
anomaly_results.implication: Low splash is a necessary retention gate, but a low-splash library still needs a second structural bias to become useful.

anomaly_results.constraint: Measure support change separately from l1 and max_abs on the 2-packet probe.
anomaly_results.observation: There are 0 support-lowering pairs, 157 low-splash pairs that lower l1, and 718 low-splash pairs that lower max_abs.
anomaly_results.implication: The real obstruction is support creation. A promising library must be support-flux screened before magnitude is optimized.

anomaly_results.constraint: Split low-splash 2-packet composites by channel pattern.
anomaly_results.observation: Among low-splash pairs, 361 are qq, 432 are ss, and only 67 are qs.
anomaly_results.implication: Cross-channel compositions are usually too entangling. Start with same-channel templates and add cross-channel links only when the defect graph justifies them.

anomaly_results.constraint: Inspect separation lengths among low-splash same-channel pairs.
anomaly_results.observation: The dominant separations are 83, 85, 81 and the short offsets 1, 2, 4.
anomaly_results.implication: The first fixed grammar should be generated from midpoint-involution pairings, tiny local offsets, and run-boundary mirrors, not from arbitrary index tuples.

anomaly_results.constraint: Demand monotone lexicographic improvement at every accepted step.
anomaly_results.observation: Both the one-packet library and the naive 2-packet library are frozen under that rule.
anomaly_results.implication: Either a retained neutral corridor exists and must be navigated explicitly, or the correct result is a no-library certificate.

anomaly_results.constraint: Enforce symmetry by hard-wiring a structured family rather than by orbit quotienting.
anomaly_results.observation: Adjacent sequence-search literature already shows that aggressive symmetry restrictions can improve tractability while hiding the best states.
anomaly_results.implication: Symmetry-safe here should mean orbit-safe and canonicalized, not family-constrained.

anomaly_results.constraint: Keep H1's current whole-library rescoring pattern after introducing composites.
anomaly_results.observation: The method would still be a global packet scorer wrapped in CA vocabulary, even if the packet library improved.
anomaly_results.implication: A credible successor must show neighborhood-only updates on the retained composite graph, otherwise the novelty collapses into large-neighborhood local search.

steering_directions.rationale: The 2-packet probe shows real low-splash cancellation structure, but it is concentrated in same-channel pairs at midpoint-scale and tiny offsets. That suggests closing those pairs into 4-packet loops that cancel first-order spill while remaining generated by a fixed grammar.
steering_directions.first_step: Enumerate same-channel templates built from offsets {1, 2, 4, 81, 83, 85} plus run-boundary mirror pairs, close them into 4-packet loops, and canonicalize them under the allowed symmetry group before any frontier scoring.
steering_directions.expected_signal: A retained subset with median changed-lag footprint at most 25 and at least one canonical-seed move that is lexicographically neutral or better with nonincreasing support.

steering_directions.direction: Defect-packet cycle basis rather than free packet tuples
steering_directions.rationale: Because magnitude reductions are plentiful but support reductions are absent, the right composite object is likely a short alternating cycle in a defect-packet graph, not an arbitrary packet tuple. This mirrors improvement-graph and trapping-set logic from adjacent fields.
steering_directions.first_step: Build a bipartite graph between active lags and packets using signed delta overlap, score external support flux on each edge, and enumerate short length-4 and length-6 cycles with near-zero external flux.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The first composite family that can lower support or keep support flat while still reducing l1 or max_abs on the canonical seed.

steering_directions.rationale: The pair probe shows that a composite can look attractive on l1 or max_abs while being fatal on support. That means support drift should be part of the library definition, not just part of the run-time objective.
steering_directions.first_step: For every candidate composite, compute extinguished active lags, newly activated inactive lags, and a net support-flux score; retain only composites with nonpositive support flux on the canonical seed and at least one harder control.
steering_directions.expected_signal: A much smaller retained library that is enriched for strategic neutral moves and eliminates most of the l1-improving but support-diffusing composites.

steering_directions.direction: Neutral-corridor controller on the retained composite graph
steering_directions.rationale: The neutral set is very thin, so any useful strategic neutrality will likely appear as short corridors in a carefully retained graph rather than as obvious single moves. A bounded self-avoiding neutral walk is the least invasive way to test that hypothesis.
steering_directions.first_step: Create a graph whose nodes are retained composites and whose edges connect composites that can be applied sequentially without breaking the splash cap; allow self-avoiding walks of length at most 8 before requiring strict improvement.
steering_directions.expected_signal: A frontier move sequence that is unreachable by monotone greedy search but reaches an improved or support-preserving state after a short neutral corridor.

steering_directions.direction: Hybrid cellular-automaton stress redistribution on the retained graph
steering_directions.rationale: If a retained library exists, the CA can become genuinely local by operating on a sparse composite graph instead of globally rescoring all candidate actions. Topology-optimization HCA is the closest operational analogy.
steering_directions.first_step: Assign each retained composite a local stress equal to weighted defect overlap minus spill risk, diffuse stress only across neighboring composites, and enforce a hard cap on simultaneously active composite mass with refractory state.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Better frontier progress than scorer-only, greedy, tabu, or annealing on the same retained library while touching only local neighborhoods during updates.

steering_directions.direction: Orbit-quotient symmetry contract with leakage audit
steering_directions.rationale: Symmetry handling needs to remove duplicates without silently turning the search into Williamson, Turyn, skew, or other known-family search. Orbit quotienting and leakage auditing should be coupled from the start.
steering_directions.first_step: Formalize the admissible symmetry group, define canonical representatives for states and composites, and add an explicit audit that rejects any retained library whose effective support lies inside a known structured family.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The retained library shrinks substantially under quotienting, but its performance metrics remain invariant under representative choice and it does not collapse into a known family.

steering_directions.direction: No-library certificate if fixed grammars still freeze
steering_directions.rationale: The current evidence is already strongly negative for 1-packet and naive 2-packet libraries. If the fixed 4-packet and cycle grammars above also fail, the honest next artifact is a stronger barrier, not another heuristic branch.
steering_directions.first_step: Choose the fixed grammars from the previous directions, exhaust them on the canonical seed and at least one harder control, and emit a machine-checkable certificate if no retained composite is score-improving or strategically neutral with nonincreasing support.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Either the first certified counterexample composite appears, or packet-space CA is retired with a sharper locality barrier than the current one-packet freeze.

checks: Fix the composite grammar before frontier scoring. Allowed ingredients are representation symmetries, run-boundary templates, and defect-graph cycle rules, not packet indices chosen because they helped this seed.
Use the same grammar and the same retention contract on the canonical seed and at least one harder control.
Canonicalize every composite under the allowed symmetry group before counting it, tuning it, or reporting it.
Reject any direction whose useful behavior requires whole-library rescoring at each step.
Measure retained-library splash on both the canonical seed and a harder control; require median changed-lag footprint at most 25 and a materially smaller upper tail than the one-packet baseline.
Verify that the useful templates arise from the fixed offset grammar rather than from seed-picked index tuples.
Require at least one canonical-seed move that is lexicographically neutral or better with nonincreasing support.

validation_checks.direction: Defect-packet cycle basis rather than free packet tuples
checks: For every retained cycle, record active-lag overlap, external support flux, and changed-lag footprint.
Confirm that the same cycle family remains meaningful after symmetry quotienting and on the harder control.
Pass only if at least one cycle lowers support or keeps support flat while lowering l1 or max_abs on the canonical seed.
Compare the retained set against a splash-only filter and show that support-flux screening removes most magnitude-improving but support-diffusing composites.
Track false positives on controls: a good screen should not discard obviously useful composites on easier exact instances.
Pass only if the screened library is enriched for nonworsening frontier moves relative to the unscreened low-splash pool.

validation_checks.direction: Neutral-corridor controller on the retained composite graph
checks: Cap walk length and forbid immediate revisits to keep the controller local and interpretable.
Compare against monotone greedy search and against an equally capped random neutral walker on the same retained graph.
Pass only if short neutral walks unlock frontier states that monotone search cannot reach.

validation_checks.direction: Hybrid cellular-automaton stress redistribution on the retained graph
checks: Instrument how many composite nodes are touched per update and verify that this stays small relative to the retained library size.
Ablate stress diffusion, refractory state, and local activity cap separately to confirm that the gain is genuinely from local CA dynamics.
Pass only if the HCA outperforms scorer-only and matched non-CA baselines on the same retained library without widening into whole-graph rescoring.

validation_checks.direction: Orbit-quotient symmetry contract with leakage audit
checks: Show invariance of counts and performance after replacing any retained composite by another representative from its orbit.
Audit whether the retained composites effectively constrain the search to a known family; fail the direction if they do.
Pass only if quotienting reduces search size materially while preserving the measured frontier behavior.

validation_checks.direction: No-library certificate if fixed grammars still freeze
checks: Make the grammar explicit and finite: list allowed offsets, run-boundary constructions, cycle lengths, and symmetry rules.
Use an exhaustive checker and save enough metadata to replay the negative result.
Pass only if the certificate covers a rule class that strictly contains the current one-packet library and the naive 2-packet library.
